disclosures.text: A motion sensor detects orientation of a handheld tool.
A processor processes detected orientation to determine if the tool is out of a predetermined tilting range.
A handheld tool is operably connected with the motion monitoring device.
A motion monitoring device for a handheld tool comprising a motion sensor detecting orientation and a processor determining if orientation is out of a predetermined tilting range.
A handheld tool arranged to be operably connected with a motion monitoring device as described in claims 1-14.
The predetermined tilting range comprises at least two of pitch, roll, and yaw ranges.
An indicator provides an indication based on the processor's determination.
The indicator comprises a visual indicator.
The visual indicator includes a display.
The display has a tilt status indication portion.
The tilt status indication portion provides a first indication when within range.
The tilt status indication portion provides a second, different indication when out of range.
The display has a plurality of tilt direction indication portions.
The tilt direction indication portions indicate respective directions of tilt.
The tilt direction indication portions are activated only when the tool is out of range.
The device comprises at least 4 tilt direction indication portions.
The device comprises at least 8 tilt direction indication portions.
The tilt direction indication portions form a substantially continuous loop.
Each tilt direction indication portion has a first segment activated when exceeding range by a first amount.
Each tilt direction indication portion has a second segment activated when the first segment is active and exceeding range by a larger second amount.
The second segment indicates the extent of tilting.
Input means adjust or calibrate the predetermined tilting range.
The motion sensor comprises a gyroscope.
The motion sensor comprises an accelerometer.
The motion sensor comprises an IMU sensor.
A wireless communication module communicates information and data with an external electronic device.
Information and data includes commands for controlling device operation.
Information and data includes commands for adjusting device settings.
Information and data includes determination results obtained by the device.
The handheld tool is a handheld power tool.
The handheld tool is a hedge trimmer.
A connection interface connects with the handheld power tool for power and/or data communication.
